i0-context.title: Load handoff and repository context
i0-context.imperative: Load the handoff, project doctrine, degraded map receipt, planning skill contracts, scripts, tests, and epic #418 source evidence. Record pass when loaded.
i0-context.finding: Loaded the handoff, project doctrine, degraded map receipt, current planning interfaces/tests, archived confirmed Context Governor spec and issue-set evidence, and local Admiral run artifacts.

q1.title: What behavior changes?
q1.imperative: Resolve the changed planning capability in behavior terms from the confirmed handoff: current-wave actionability, forecast status, evidence intake, wave-exit decisions, and fixed-boundary preservation.
q1.finding: The system changes from exhaustive pre-execution issue graphs to current-wave-only actionability: a compact epic owns fixed intent/done/good-enough/constraints, a nonbinding forecast and uncertainty register; execution evidence is classified before issue creation; each boundary produces advance/repair/replan/stop; unlaunched work is revisable while fixed boundaries require escalation.

q2.title: Which current interfaces carry the change?
q2.imperative: Resolve the current seams across Explorer, to-issues, verifier, filer/adapters, installer/index, and Admiral. Identify which are load-bearing and which can remain unchanged.
q2.finding: Load-bearing seams are verify_issue_set and file_issue_set manifest/rendering plus the new lean replan contract. The current MarkdownAdapter/idempotency receipt/GitHubAdapter ports remain valid. Installer bundles/index/tests must follow the canonical rename. Explorer route/spec and Admiral execution doctrine change; checklist engine, Commander, Cartographer, episode store, and tracker port do not need redesign.

q3.title: What proves the #418 counterfactual?
q3.imperative: Resolve the source-of-truth inputs for epic #418, baseline issue/edge counts, required demonstration outputs, and the offline/no-write evidence path.
q3.finding: The archived 2026-07-18 Context Governor confirmed spec and ISSUE_SET are the counterfactual inputs. Baseline: 5 runnable issues, 3 dependency edges, 3,798 epic-body words by repository-local regex (3,705 spec words). The new demo must emit five named Markdown artifacts under this run, use the Markdown/offline adapter only, and preserve intent/constraints/decisions/evidence/completion while showing one coherent first execution-and-validation loop.

q4.title: Is the protected intent correctly understood?
q4.imperative: Present the consolidated problem statement, recommended implementation boundary, and principal risks to the human. Obtain explicit confirmation that this is the intended first version before planning.
q4.finding: Human answered Confirmed to the consolidated protected intent and implementation boundary.

zc-consolidate.title: Consolidate behind the finish gate
zc-consolidate.imperative: Write INTERROGATION_RECORD.json with typed fact/decision evidence and the human's explicit joint-understanding sign-off. Verify it with verify_interrogation.py, record pass, consolidate, then release the survey lease.
zc-consolidate.finding: Joint understanding recorded and verify_interrogation.py passed.

consolidation.summary: Protected intent and bounded implementation approach confirmed by the human.
